description:
This file serves as the standardized enrollment confirmation template for citizen nwo-citizen0001, Pat Tarwater Jr, upon acceptance into the Information Technology program at South University. It is designed for integration into Beast System 3.0 as a deterministic artifact that records academic onboarding milestones without storing sensitive personal identifiers. The template provides a structured format for documenting acceptance, orientation requirements, communication from South University, and initial course registration steps.

The confirmation template includes the following sections: Section 1: Acceptance Verification, used to record the official acceptance notice from South University, including term start date, modality, and program details. Section 2: Orientation Requirements, outlining mandatory orientation sessions, online onboarding modules, and any technology setup required by the institution. Section 3: Advisor Assignment, providing space to document the assigned academic advisor, contact information, and initial advising session details. Section 4: Enrollment Tasks, listing required steps such as submitting final transcripts, completing identity verification, and confirming residency or tuition classification. Section 5: Course Registration Preparation, detailing how to review the program curriculum, identify first-term courses, and prepare for registration through the university’s student portal.

This file acts as a canonical reference for Beast System 3.0 academic modules, ensuring that enrollment processes remain consistent, organized, and aligned with the strategic growth objectives of New World Order DAO and Beast System 3.0. It does not perform enrollment automatically; instead, it provides a deterministic structure that the citizen manually completes upon receiving official communication from South University.
